note: class: training = collects data for model training; search = builds an AI search index; user = fetches a page because a person asked. probeUserAgent is sent to the site to see how it answers that crawler; it contains the crawler's token, which is what user-agent based blocking matches on, but is not guaranteed to be the vendor's exact current string. Crawlers with probeUserAgent null are robots.txt-only tokens with no user agent of their own.
